plainLanguage: Roughly one chest muscle in three differs in some way from the textbook description.
qualifiers: One cadaveric series of 40 cadavers (22 male, 18 female) yielding 80 specimens. The donors had a mean age of 69.3 (SD 11.8) years, range 48 to 90. The first pass stated that donor age was not in the retrieved text; it is stated in the Material and Methods, and the correction is recorded.

A mean donor age of 69.3 years is a material applicability limitation for a claim about typical adult structure presented to lifters, and it is the reason applicability is now recorded as indirect rather than partially-direct.
The proportion is specific to this series and to its classification scheme.

conditions: gross dissection of 80 pectoralis major specimens
scope.population: 40 adult cadavers of both sexes, 22 male and 18 female

sourceLinks.locator: Results, proportion of typical structure and the variation classification

statement: The typical pectoralis major configuration was observed in 63.75 per cent of 80 cadaveric specimens, with a separate clavicular portion the most frequent variation.
